description:
WHAT: Put the original values back into texts (typically an LLM answer) that contain placeholders such as [EMAIL_1], using the placeholder map from pii_redact_text or pii_guard_documents. Runs 100% on your machine.
WHEN: After an LLM or third party answered a prompt you sanitized with pii_redact_text (redactionStyle "placeholder", returnPlaceholderMap=true), before showing the answer to the user.
WHEN NOT: To redact (pii_redact_text) or find PII (pii_scan_text). Masked and hashed values cannot be restored; only placeholder style is reversible.
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One "restored_document" row per text with output_text, replacements and unknown_placeholders. Errors: INPUT_TOO_LARGE.
BEHAVIOR: No network calls; the map never leaves your machine; milliseconds. Max 50 texts, 200,000 chars each, 500,000 total; map up to 10,000 entries.
PARAMETERS: placeholderMap: pass meta.placeholder_map unchanged; every key is replaced wherever it occurs exactly (case-sensitive, longest key first, one pass, so a restored value is never replaced again). unknown_placeholders lists [TYPE_N]-shaped tokens left in the text that the map does not contain (the LLM invented or altered them); they stay as they are. A placeholder the LLM rewrote (e.g. "EMAIL_1" without brackets) is not restored. The output contains the ORIGINAL sensitive values: show it to the user, do not send it back to the LLM. limit/offset page whole documents (default 10 per page).
EXAMPLE: {"texts":["I will email [EMAIL_1] today."],"placeholderMap":{"[EMAIL_1]":"jane@acme.com"}} -> output_text "I will email jane@acme.com today.", replacements 1.

limit.description: Optional page size: items to return, integer 1-50 (default 10). Example: 10

offset.description: Optional zero-based number of items to skip, integer 0-1000000 (default 0); pass nextOffset from the previous response, e.g. 100

placeholderMap.description: Required. Object placeholder -> original value, as returned in meta.placeholder_map by pii_redact_text (or placeholder_map by pii_guard_documents); keys 1-200 chars, values <= 10,000 chars, <= 10,000 entries. Example: {"[EMAIL_1]":"jane@acme.com","[PHONE_1]":"+14155550100"}

texts.description: Required. 1-50 documents (prompt, chat message, log, file content), each <= 200,000 chars, total <= 500,000 chars. Example: ["Mail jane@acme.com, key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"]

name: pii_restore_text

count.description: Number of items in this page

hasMore.description: True if more items exist after this page

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null

offset.description: Offset of the first item in this page

title: Restore placeholders with original values (free, local)
